title: Kirtland security meeting with Benowitz where attendees leave
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: he told me by the end of the meet everybody started leaving and by the end of the meeting there was like three or four people left because they're like oh that's not ours.

plain: In 1980, at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, a security meeting was reportedly held about Paul Bennewitz, an Albuquerque man who believed he was tracking alien activity near the base. As the strange things he reported were discussed, people supposedly got up and left, one after another, saying "oh, that's not ours," until only three or four remained. The writer Greg Bishop tells Michels this second-hand, from a man named Tom Deuley who told him about the meeting; if true, it would mean the people in the room could not claim what Bennewitz had seen as any of their own projects.
